messages:
Leah (Events): T-minus 7. Quick change: encoder reported a CRC hiccup in the last rehearsal. planning to swap preview to encoder-standby. mic check in 4.
ops-bot: alert: encoder-1 crc_error_count=4 at 1768259980
Omar (AV): Rebinding preview to encoder-standby now. will keep primary on air unless we see packet loss. command: `ingestctl switch --preview encoder-standby`
Rhea (Eng): Mirroring ingest and warming backup recorder. also bumping jitter buffer to avoid pops: `encctl set-jitter conservative`
Omar (AV): Preview now on encoder-standby. OBS scene stable but captions from fallback are ~6s behind live.
Leah (Events): Noted — Eve will call out captions lag during intros. Also we need the one-liner about Dedicated for the roadmap slide.
Eve (CEO): Use: "Expanding Dedicated regions this quarter to improve latency and compliance." I'll speak to it.
Tom (Presenter): Quick mic check — switching to headset now. noticed a soft hum when on laptop battery.
Rhea (Eng): If hum persists, we'll mute laptop channel and route headset only. snapshot scheduled +90s after stop to prevent tail trim.
Omar (AV): Local recorder warming: `ssh av@rec-2 && sudo systemctl start rdw-recorder-backup` — started at 1768260025
ops-bot: recording: backup-recorder started at 1768260026
Leah (Events): Q&A workflow reminder: if a question needs follow-up, tag #post-allhands and prefix with "followup:" plus an owner. we'll triage in the morning.
Omar (AV): One more caveat: when we flip slides during demos there is a ~1s blank in some players. I'll do a silent scene-refresh during the transition to mask it.
Tom (Presenter): thanks — I'll pause for a beat on transitions.
Eve (CEO): During Q&A I'll take roadmap and infra questions. For security/legal, ask people to include 'followup: security' in their message.
Rhea (Eng): ops note: archive jobs sometimes drop the last 20s if stop-recorder is immediate. we'll hold stop +90s.
Leah (Events): Confirmed stop +90s. Also action routing: new rule — prefix action items with "ACTION:" and include an owner. we'll compile and assign tomorrow.
Omar (AV): OBS green, preview stable, viewers nominal, bitrate 3.1Mbps. captions fallback ~6s delayed as mentioned.
ops-bot: ingest: switched preview -> encoder-standby at 1768260040
Leah (Events): All set. rolling in 2 minutes. final checklist: mention captions lag, ACTION: prefix for follow-ups, stop +90s. ready?
Tom (Presenter): Ready. Let's go. :rocket:
